title: Sample: two cases, solo vs same family vs mixed (fake models)

expert.prompt: You are one of the experts on this case. Read the task and the materials, then give your analysis in plain text.

moderator.prompt: You lead the discussion. Read the experts' analyses and decide.

judge.prompt: Score the final recommendation against the reference notes.

cases.task: A neighbourhood bakery's sales fell 20% in a year. Recommend what it should do first.

materials.facts.md: Foot traffic unchanged. A chain cafe opened next door. Prices rose 15%.

cases.secret: Reference: the price rise, not the cafe, explains most of the drop.

cases.task: A small clinic has long waits on Mondays only. Recommend one change.

materials.facts.md: Same staff every day. Monday has twice the walk-ins.

cases.secret: Reference: move one weekday booking block to Monday walk-ins.
